content: Does anyone know how hard it would be to set up a cache for PhysLib, similar to what Mathlib has? Has any other project done something similar?

#general > Cache for PhysLean and projects downstream of Mathlib

My impression is that we just have to wait, but maybe there have been updates behind the scenes
Yes, this is being very actively worked on. We'll certainly have a solution for you in the next 1-3 months, hopefully on the early side of that!
I believe that this has now hit, and we can make a cache for Physlib :). Will investigate later.

Hi everyone, I've implemented this cache so now you can run lake exe get_cache after cloning the repo. The script will get both mathlib and physlibs caches and make the build much quicker. This is also being used in the linters to massively speed up the checks. Please let me know if you experience any issues as I have not been able to test it much on devices other than my own.

Many thanks Alex for doing this! Just to highlight the important part:

  • Historically: lake exe cache get; lake build
  • Now use: lake exe get_cache; lake build

This latter command downloads the Physlib cache so you don't have to build it!
Does this point to newest master or the last version update?
